children: a proposal to change the company’s name to “Jinko Holdings Limited.”

The proposed name change is subject to approval of shareholders at its annual general meeting to be held on October 21. Following completion of the proposed name change, American depositary shares are expected to continue trading on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “JKS.”
The proposed name change reflects the company’s evolving role at the group level following the listing and continued development of Jinko Solar Co. Ltd., its majority-owned operating subsidiary.

Going forward, the company plans to pursue two complementary value-creation strategies. The first will focus on its industrial holdings, maintaining its controlling stake in Jinko Solar, whose integrated solar and energy-storage businesses remain the core of the group.

The second will center on strategic investments, with the company seeking minority stakes in high-growth sectors benefiting from China’s technological innovation, industrial upgrading and energy transition.
Representative investments in its current portfolio include Moonshot AI, StepFun, SiliconFlow, Noetix Robotics, Taiyi Quantum and Janbon Metallic Materials.

title: JinkoSolar board approves name change to Jinko Holdings
